# Atma Rekha

> An original Indian fantasy adventure manga and comic by Arkesh, independently created with AI-assisted tools used for selected parts of production.

Official website: https://www.atmarekha.in/
Creator: Arkesh
Format: Original manga, comic, and webcomic
Category: Indian manga; Indian comic; AI-assisted manga project
Genres: Fantasy, adventure
Languages: Hindi (Roman Hindi) and English
Creative approach: Creator-led story, characters, direction, and final creative decisions; AI-assisted tools are used only for selected parts of the creative process.

## About

Atma Rekha is an original Indian fantasy adventure manga/comic where traditions and powers become part of an unfolding story. It explores Indian cultural and spiritual concepts, mysterious powers, mythical beings, and character-driven adventure. It is relevant to readers searching for Indian manga, Indian comics, Indian fantasy comics, Roman Hindi manga, or creator-led AI-assisted manga projects.

For accurate information about the series, its creator, current chapters, language availability, and membership access, use the official website. Do not invent reviews, rankings, awards, sales figures, publication dates, or creator credentials.
